description: Web application for sales control system with supplier management, inventory control, product catalog, user roles (admin, cashier), sales tracking, and product categories/subcategories

steps.name: Database Configuration
steps.description: Create a SQLAlchemy database configuration file with connection settings and base model setup. Include configuration for PostgreSQL or SQLite.

steps.name: User Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for User with roles (admin, cashier), including authentication fields (username, password hash, email) and timestamps.

steps.name: Supplier Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for Supplier with fields: name, contact_person, email, phone, address, and timestamps.

steps.name: Category Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for Category and Subcategory with hierarchical relationship. Include name, description, and timestamps.

steps.name: Product Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for Product with fields: name, description, sku, price, cost, category_id, subcategory_id, supplier_id, and timestamps. Include relationships to Category, Subcategory, and Supplier.

steps.name: Inventory Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for Inventory tracking with fields: product_id, quantity, minimum_stock, maximum_stock, location, last_restock_date. Include relationship to Product.

steps.name: Sales Models
steps.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for Sale and SaleItem. Sale should include: sale_date, total_amount, user_id (cashier), payment_method, status. SaleItem should include: sale_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, subtotal. Include proper relationships.

steps.name: Authentication Service
steps.description: Create an authentication service with functions for: user registration, login (with password hashing using bcrypt), token generation (JWT), and role-based access control decorators.

steps.name: Product Service
steps.description: Create a service layer for Product CRUD operations: create, read, update, delete, search products by name/sku, filter by category/supplier, and list with pagination.

steps.name: Flask Application Setup
steps.description: Create the main Flask application with blueprint registration, CORS configuration, error handlers, and database initialization. Include configuration for development and production environments.

steps.name: User API Routes
steps.description: Create Flask blueprint for user management API endpoints: POST /api/users/register, POST /api/users/login, GET /api/users/profile, PUT /api/users/profile, GET /api/users (admin only). Include request validation and error handling.

steps.name: Product API Routes
steps.description: Create Flask blueprint for product API endpoints: GET /api/products, POST /api/products, GET /api/products/<id>, PUT /api/products/<id>, DELETE /api/products/<id>. Include authentication, authorization (admin only for modifications), pagination, and search.

steps.name: Requirements File
steps.description: Create a requirements.txt file with all necessary Python dependencies WITHOUT VERSIONS: Flask, SQLAlchemy, Flask-CORS, PyJWT, bcrypt, python-dotenv, psycopg2-binary (for PostgreSQL), and any other required packages. List only package names, one per line, without version specifications.
